messages:
Kai: Quick sync — can we move the benchmark readout from Tue -> Wed? I have a calendar conflict at 2pm PT.
Priya: Wed works for me, mornings better tho. 10-11am PT?
Alex: 10am PT is ok. who will present the latency slides?
Kai: I can present the recent 8k sequence results but need someone to cover cost breakdown (p50/p95 cost per token) and the dashboard walk. @Priya?
Priya: I can take cost + dashboard. I'll prepare the per-model cost table and highlight the quantized runs.
Jo: Heads-up — observed a p95 jump on the 8k seq with KV cache disabled in the last run. Need to confirm it's not a scheduling artifact. Can we add a triage slot?
Kai: Good call. Agenda draft: 1) quick status (5m) 2) benchmark readout (15m) 3) triage p95 regression (10m) 4) quantization tradeoffs + rollout decision (15m) 5) action items (5m).
Sam: Is 45m total okay? Might be tight but doable.
Priya: 45m fine. I'll post the link to the latency/cost dashboard before the meeting and attach the CSV of runs.
Alex: Leave 5 mins for Qs from product — they asked to join for the cost part.
Kai: Noted. Can someone ping infra to reserve a dedicated bench slot? We need deterministic capacity to re-run the failing 8k case.
Sam: I'll open a request with eng-infra now. request id: INF-4721. ETA for slot: Wed 9:30am PT if approved.
Priya: Perfect, that gives us time to re-run before 10.
Jo: For the regression triage, I'll bring the perf logs and the kernel selection traces.
Kai: Thanks. Action owners: Kai=bench readout, Priya=cost dashboard + CSV, Jo=triage logs, Sam=infra slot.
Priya: I'll also include a short note on the batching config we used (batch size, dynamic batching window).
Alex: Quick code-review ping: I left comments on the bench harness PR (#412). Can someone take a look before we re-run? It's about a caching flag.
Jo: I'll review PR #412 today.
Sam: deploy-bot: booking request INF-4721 submitted by Sam, status: pending.
deploy-bot: booking update INF-4721: approved, reserved Wed 09:30-10:30 PT on bench-pool-a.
Kai: Awesome. Wed 10am PT it is. I'll update the calendar invite and the agenda in the meeting doc. Please :thumbsup: if you can make it.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Alex: :thumbsup:
Jo: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Kai: If anything blocks, drop updates in this thread. Thanks!
